cr_data.provenance:
By November 5, 1953, Downtown Gallery, New York (stock no. 98) [see note 1]; April 21, 1955, sold by Downtown Gallery to the William H. Lane Foundation, Leominster, MA [see note 2]; 1990, gift of the William H. Lane Foundation to the MFA. (Accession Date: September 18, 1990) 
 
NOTES: 
[1] This painting appears on a stock list of O’Keeffe paintings, dated November 5, 1953. Archives of American Art, Downtown Gallery Records, Series 4, Business Records: Miscellaneous Stock Records, O’Keeffe, Georgia: Reel 5609 (Box 64), Frame 763. 
 
[2] Archives of American Art, Downtown Gallery Records, Series 4, Business Records: Sales Slips (1 of 2), 1955: Reel 5628 (Box 72), Frame 170. 
(Source: MFA Boston, 2025)
remarks_1999: Whitney Archive indicates, "Exam. at Amer. Place, March 1946. . . . No signature. On backing: 'Calla Lily on Grey 1926?'" [not verified]. Pictured in 1933 New York (An American Place) Stieglitz installation photograph, see Appendix III, figure 54. Abiquiú Notebooks mistakenly associates cat. no. 586 as work in 1933 exhibition. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.title: Calla Lily on Grey

credit_line: Gift of the William H. Lane Foundation
description: A white calla lily with a bright green stem occupies the center of the composition. Behind the lily is a background composed of draped gray fabric.
imageCaption: Image courtesy of a scanned transparency made for Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné. This image has not been color proofed and may differ from the original. It will be replaced when newer photography becomes available.
